subject: infra.cybersec
name: Critical national infrastructure designation
what_would_settle_it: enactment of the cybersecurity law, or a standalone decree, would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the December 2025 presidential decree vests the designation power in a new cybersecurity centre but publishes no designation list, and the National Assembly adopted the cybersecurity bill in its final vote on 2026-08-12, with no promulgation on file at 2026-09-17

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cybersecurity fund
what_would_settle_it: a constitutive decree would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, no constitutive decree exists; the fund appears only as a named destination for 30% of the cybersecurity centre's revenue

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Count of public services available online
what_would_settle_it: a published service catalogue or a completion report would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the government's own eServices catalogue names seven services but is undated and the portal root is in maintenance

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Installed AI compute capacity
what_would_settle_it: the readiness assessment's infrastructure case rests on fibre, one satellite and data centres; probed 2026-08-05, no document states installed capacity; the nearest published measures are regional aggregates in a July 2026 IMF paper

subject: include.access
name: Digital inclusion grants component
what_would_settle_it: a procurement or disbursement report would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, the World Bank implementation status report gives component costs and disbursement; the governing programme manual was still to be drafted

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital-literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: a ministry or education programme document would settle it; probed 2026-08-05, no standalone programme document exists; the national digital skills strategy is recorded as still to be developed

subject: finance.sustain
name: Source of financing against the digital budget lines
what_would_settle_it: A budget annex or PIP listing printing the source of financing (domestic or external) per project; the 2024 and 2025 laws print it only for the budget as a whole.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: Annexes 12, 13 and 16 of the fourth-quarter budget execution report (execution by budget unit and project) for FY2024 or FY2025, or the Conta Geral do Estado, read into the budget extract.

subject: finance.sustain
name: FY2026 enacted budget, digital lines
what_would_settle_it: The enacted OGE 2026 volume (Dotação Orçamental por Órgão), read into the budget extract; FY2026 holds reporting-sourced rows only.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: Adoption of the Política Nacional de Gestão e Hospedagem de Dados Públicos and its regulation, procured under terms of reference of March 2026.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the government cloud agreements
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the Presight and G42 contract terms or the operating agreement for the Camama government data centre and cloud.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Source code, operating skills and exit for the PGIBI identity platform
what_would_settle_it: A contract, audit or ministry statement on source-code ownership and exit terms for the CEIEC-coordinated identity platform.
